parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. Although the two test methods `ReviewRequestServiceTests.shouldRequestReviewAtThreshold` (line 90) and `ReviewRequestServiceTests.didRequestReviewResetsState` (line 153) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.769), they are distinct test scenarios — one verifies threshold-triggered review requests and the other verifies state reset after a review request — and their near-duplicate shape is a natural consequence of the arrange-act-assert test pattern rather than accidental duplication. Merging or abstracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated behavioural assertions.
